topojson-client.min.js is the official UMD build, copied unmodified from npm
via jsdelivr on 2026-09-19:

  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/dist/topojson-client.min.js

ISC, copyright Mike Bostock. The only consumer is js/data.js, which decodes
the TopoJSON land layers in base/ (world-atlas ships land as TopoJSON, which
is about a third the size of the equivalent GeoJSON).

Do not edit this file.
